decided: 2026-11-05 by the author: both configurations are run by hand; no scripted provider adapter
replaces_for_protocol_4: paper2/preparation/v3/configurations.json (kept unchanged as a historical record)
operation: The author runs each session by hand from a workspace prepared by paper2/preparation/sessions.py. The agent runs on the host, not in a container. The prompt text is identical for both configurations.

limits.enforcement: Stated in the prompt and watched by the operator; observed in the logs, not enforced in code. A patch counts as resolved only if the session stayed within both limits.

configurations.telemetry: Conversation export with tool calls; model name as shown in the interface or export, recorded by the operator with its location; step count recorded by the operator with the counting method.
configurations.network: Not observable unless the operator records the terminal and network settings in effect.

training_cutoff.value: March 2026; some domains end at January 2025

configurations.telemetry: Codex session log: turn_context gives model, effort, and sandbox policy as reported by the client; tool calls give the step count; token_usage_record gives tokens.
configurations.network: The workspace-write sandbox runs commands without network access when the log reports network_access false.
